author: TeIq
content: Origin: #31. AtprotoOauthAuthVerifier is constructed at startup but not bound to HTTP routes. Need: POST /auth/atproto/login (handle in body → call start_login → 303 Location), GET /auth/atproto/callback (state+code from query → call complete_login → set Polaris session cookie → 303 to /). Mirror polaris-backend/src/api/auth_oidc.rs (if exists) or follow the OIDC route shape. Wire into api/router with the same middleware-exempt pattern as OIDC routes.
